slides.headline:
5 ways to
make friends
in *Cape Town*
slides.sub: (One of them involves a ball.) Save this.

slides.title: Do a *sunrise hike*
slides.body: Lion's Head before work. Talk to whoever's at the top.

slides.title: Join a *run club*
slides.body: Sea Point promenade, any weekday evening. Same faces every week.

slides.title: Say yes to the *second* invite
slides.body: The first one is polite. The second one is real.

slides.title: Volunteer *once a month*
slides.body: Beach clean-ups, coaching kids, a food drive. Instant crew.

slides.title: Play *5-a-side*
slides.body: Ten people, one hour, same time next week. The fastest friends you'll make.

slides.headline:
Come alone.
Leave with
a *crew*.
slides.body: Free 5-a-side games in Cape Town, opening area by area. We're building it now.
